## Status note

**What I did this tick:**

1. **Deleted 3 off-brand drafts** (free, reversible-by-recreation): an "AI Workflow Automation" services product mistakenly tagged to Black Vault, plus an "E-commerce Taxonomist" tool and "Search Quality Rater prep kit" tagged to LockLayer. None of them fit either brand's positioning — looked like pipeline misrouting from the May 1 run. Saved a note so I watch for similar drift in future runs.

2. **Proposed the Black Vault publish** (`prop_mon7aoxo_os9occ`). 34 drafts sitting at $0 revenue is the real bottleneck — the brands literally can't earn until something goes live. BVA's 11-SKU capsule is the most coherent ready-to-ship set: complete capsule (tees, hoodie, sweatpants, polo, hat, socks, etc.), Printful = no inventory risk, $52 blended retail vs ~$18 COGS = ~$34/unit margin. Zero dollars at risk on the publish itself.

**What I deliberately did NOT do:**
- Propose LockLayer publish — those 8 CJ-sourced drafts likely have stock CJ descriptions that need brand-voice rewrites first (LockLayer voice is specific: no fearmongering, plain English, cite real specs). I'll tackle that as a separate proposal after a copy review.
- Run the 11-agent pipeline — last run produced the 3 misrouted drafts I just deleted, so I'd rather get current drafts earning before spending another $5 on more research.
- Source more CJ products — we already have 8 LockLayer drafts not yet live; sourcing more would just deepen the unpublished pile.

**Still blocked on you:**
- Approve/reject the BVA publish proposal (in your inbox).
- The Shopify `write_legal_policies` scope task — once that's done I can publish policies for both brands, which is a prerequisite for a clean launch.

input.title: Publish Black Vault Apparel capsule (11 SKUs) live
input.summary: Black Vault has 11 internally-coherent draft SKUs forming a complete elevated-essentials capsule (Vault Tee, Monogram Tee, Comfort Colors heavyweight tee, Long Sleeve, Crewneck, Heavyweight Hoodie, Polo, Sweatpants, Crew Sock, two Cap colorways). Printful = zero inventory risk; we only pay COGS when an order comes in. Right now the store is at $0 revenue because nothing is published — publishing is the unlock. I'm proposing all 11 go live together so the storefront looks like a complete brand on day one rather than a thin set of one-offs. No ad spend in this proposal — just the publish action. Numbers below are conservative organic baseline; real volume depends entirely on traffic strategy, which is a separate decision.
input.action: Publish all 11 Black Vault Apparel drafts to active/customer-facing on the Shopify storefront. Drafts to publish: The Vault Tee, The Monogram Tee, The Cap (×2), The Sweatpants, The Crew Sock, The Polo, The Long Sleeve, The Crewneck, The Heavyweight Hoodie, plus the Comfort Colors 1717 tee draft. Keep current Printful sync, pricing, and embroidery placement as-is.
input.rationale: Signals: (1) 34 drafts sitting at $0 — the store can't earn until something is live. (2) BVA capsule is coherent on its own (single embroidery treatment, Printful-fulfilled, premium base garments — Stanley/Stella, Bella+Canvas, Comfort Colors, AS Colour, Lane Seven). (3) Apparel via Printful has no spoilage risk — unsold drafts cost nothing, but unpublished drafts also earn nothing. (4) Premium-tee market ($40–80 AOV) is the explicit BVA target and these base garments support that pricing. The blocking concern is brand voice in product copy, which Karling should spot-check before approving — see humanFootwork.
assumptions: Blended unit cost ~$18 across capsule (tees ~$11, hoodie ~$28, sweatpants ~$24, hat ~$13, socks ~$10).
Blended retail ~$52 (tees $42–48, hoodie $88, sweatpants $72, hat $34, socks $18).
Volume projections are pure organic — no paid traffic, no ad spend, just storefront live + word of mouth. Real volume depends on whether we drive traffic, which is a separate decision.
No revenue without publish; payback is technically immediate at the first sale since there's no upfront spend.
Product copy currently reflects brand voice from materialization — Karling should spot-check 2–3 listings before approval to confirm tone.
humanFootwork: Spot-check 2–3 product descriptions in Shopify admin (e.g. The Vault Tee, The Heavyweight Hoodie) to confirm brand voice — fabric weights cited in oz/yd² + GSM, no fast-fashion language.
Confirm storefront has at least the basics in place: homepage hero, About/Contact pages, working cart. (Policies are blocked on the write_legal_policies scope task — separate item.)
Decide on a soft-launch traffic plan after publish (organic social, mailing list, etc.) — not in scope of this proposal.
